name: Quinn Huitzil
role: Covert entry and social penetration specialist — infiltrator
location: The Spires — mid-level corporate residential towers, near Lake Shore Drive and North
description:
Malika Akerblom-Manu are wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 32, scars map their face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible — thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed — and they make no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left them with skills and night terrors in equal measure. They work as a infiltrator out of The Spires, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Malika Akerblom-Manu describe them as a precision instrument — point them at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
psychology.secret: Malika Akerblom-Manu murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "The best disguise is being exactly who they expect to see."
"I was in the building for six hours before anyone realized I didn't work there."
"Security is a story people tell themselves. I'm the plot twist."

story_hooks: Malika Akerblom-Manu intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
Someone is impersonating Malika Akerblom-Manu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A Tier 4 executive offers Malika Akerblom-Manu a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Malika Akerblom-Manu functions as a connector — their work puts them in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving them naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed. Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Independent — maintains network of professional contacts

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.heritage: Indigenous American (primarily Mesoamerican) with significant Hispanic/Latin American, Eastern European, and Northern European ancestry. High cheekbones and strong facial structure reflect Mesoamerican heritage; warm brown skin tone carries the complexity of multi-continental ancestry blending.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with corded muscle — built for speed and precision rather than power. Compact frame with minimal body fat; every movement economical and controlled.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight braid, utilitarian — no ornament, designed for function during infiltration work
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle cybernetic gold rim at pupil edge — thermal masking system integration
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with subtle golden undertones; carries a slight pallor from nocturnal living. The tone reflects the blending of Indigenous American and Latin American heritage with Northern European ancestry.
physical_description.complexion: High, defined cheekbones characteristic of Indigenous American ancestry. Face mapped with thin scar tissue — left cheekbone, across right temple, along jawline. Scars are old, healed clean but visible under certain light. Minimal facial hair; sparse and fine. Eyes carry exhaustion and calculation in equal measure, set deep with slight epicanthic folding.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar across right temple to cheekbone, approximately 8cm, likely from shrapnel or blade
Linear scar along left jaw line, faded white, suggests old laceration
Burn scar on inside of left wrist — small, circular, consistent with old electrical contact or device malfunction
Network of thin white scars across both knuckles — accumulated from years of hand-to-hand work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome thermal masking system visible along lateral neck and upper spine — burnished titanium-grade plating integrated into skin, circuit-line aesthetics visible under strong light. Hydraulic joint articulation visible at elbows and knees — subtle mechanical definition at joints, chrome accents where synthetic meets flesh. Movement reveals the augmentation: precision, inhuman fluidity in absorbing impact.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless, economical. Never fully still — fingers tap, weight shifts, eyes scan. When moving with purpose, motion is silent and controlled, almost predatory. Sits with visibility of exits. Stands with weight on balls of feet, ready for vertical departure.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 infiltration wear: dark tactical pants with reinforced seams and hidden pockets, fitted black compression shirt under a matte-finish corpo-adjacent jacket in charcoal gray (stolen or black-market, carries no corporate insignia). Boots are military-grade synthleather, scuffed but maintained. No jewelry. Augmentations deliberately left visible — signal of competence and warning. Clothing prioritizes mobility and function; brand markers are utilitarian military surplus or unmarked tactical brands.
